feed.title: Scarface decomp: new matches
feed.subtitle: Functions of Scarface: The World Is Yours rebuilt in C++ that compiles to the exact same bytes.

entry.title: sub_0029A390 (Xbox, 18 bytes) by RRutherrfordd (Founder)
entry.summary: Sets a shader's BLMD setting, then works out its blend mode and alpha reference again (sub_0029A2F0). 0x0029A390 in the Xbox version, matched byte for byte with its original.

entry.title: sub_0029A2F0 (Xbox, 146 bytes) by RRutherrfordd (Founder)
entry.summary: Works out a shader's blend mode (a fading solid surface blends) and its alpha reference: ACTH times the opacity, kept to 0..1. 0x0029A2F0 in the Xbox version, matched byte for byte with its original.

entry.title: sub_00251310 (Xbox, 62 bytes) by RRutherrfordd (Founder)
entry.summary: The archive name hash: skips one leading backslash, then hash * 31 + each character (signed, 0x20 added below 'a'); 0 for null. 0x00251310 in the Xbox version, matched byte for byte with its original.
